text:
Maya (Sales): Tom from Acme pinged asking for explicit BCP/DR evidence for SIG review — they want RTO/RPO numbers, backup cadence, failover steps, and any recent DR test reports. Can we assemble a redacted runbook excerpt + test artifacts by EOD?

Tom (Acme IT): Thanks Maya — vendor risk team is asking for: 1) RTO/RPO commitments for hosted API and dedicated deployments; 2) nightly/continuous backup cadence and retention; 3) cross-region failover procedure and estimated failover time; 4) past test dates + summary (tabletop + failover). They also asked for a redacted runbook to attach to the SIG.

Ethan (SE): Quick answers to start (we can expand in a doc):
- Hosted API SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime. Dedicated SLA (contract): 99.95%.
- RTO targets: control plane failover target ~30 min (we aim <15m for most recoveries); stateless serving nodes: automatic immediate reschedule (RTO ~2–5 min for traffic routing); stateful metadata (customer configs, deployments): RTO target 30–60 min depending on retention tier.
- RPO: for critical metadata and configs <=1 hour (snapshots every 1h), for logs/telemetry best-effort shorter (KV caches ephemeral, not durable).
- Backups: model artifacts and customer configs snapshot every 6h (incremental), full daily snapshot retained 30 days by default; optional extended retention available for enterprise customers. All backups encrypted with KMS and stored in multi-AZ buckets.
- Failover: cross-region failover via active-passive routing + Health checks + automated promotion of standby. Typical DNS + LB re-route observed in <5 min in our tests; full control-plane promotion historically 10–45 min depending on data sync.
- DR testing cadence: tabletop quarterly, partial failover drills semi-annual, full customer-impacting failover tests yearly by request (requires coordination).

Ethan (SE): I can drop a redacted runbook excerpt (remove internal run-level secrets & operator phone numbers) and a one-page RTO/RPO matrix for SIG. Example excerpt we can share:```
DR RUNBOOK - EXCERPT
1) Detect: multiple ALB health-checks fail > 2m && control-plane error > 5%
2) Escalate: oncall -> eng-sre -> priya-security (notify legal)
3) Failover plan: promote standby region (runbook step id: FR-02)
4) Validate: smoke test endpoints, token issuance, verify model cache priming
5) Rollback: traffic switchback instructions
```

Priya (Security): I can provide a redacted runbook + a signed attestation summary for the SIG/CAIQ. We will remove operator contact details and redact internal IPs. We'll also include encryption key management details: KMS with CMKs per customer where required, HSM option for Private.

Priya (Security): Also note: for Hosted we do not persist request-level user content by default (see data flow summary). If Acme requires stricter RPO/RTO on user data, recommend Dedicated/Private with backup/replication options configured.

Maya (Sales): Tom — is Acme ok with a redacted runbook + a short RTO/RPO matrix + last two DR test summaries? They said they need it for vendor risk sign-off this week.

Tom (Acme IT): Yes, redacted + matrix + test dates/summaries is perfect. If you can include the last full failover date and a short outcome (pass/partial/fail) that helps. Also they asked whether backups are customer-scoped and whether we can provide a sample backup manifest.

Ethan (SE): We can provide a sample backup manifest (redacted) and last full failover: 2025-10-12 (partial; control plane promotion tested, small rollback required due to config mismatch, remediated in 45m). Tabletop 2025-07-21 (pass). I will attach the sample manifest and matrix. Sample manifest snippet:```
backup_id: bkp-20251012-acme
type: full
created_at: 2025-10-12T03:12:00Z
objects: [configs, model-metadata, customer-manifests]
encrypted: true
retention_days: 30
```

runbook-bot: Document uploaded: s3://redwood-dr/ACME/redacted-runbook-2026-01-15.pdf (permissions: sales+security+legal) :white_check_mark:

Ana (Legal): I'll review the redactions and sign off on attachments for external sharing. If Acme requires a signed attestation we can issue one; confirm whether they need company-wide or per-deployment wording.

Priya (Security): Action items: @Ethan produce RTO/RPO matrix + sample manifest; @Ana review redactions; @Maya share runbook link with Acme and ask whether they want non-redacted evidence under NDA. ETA: EOD for initial packet.

Maya (Sales): Thanks team — I'll share the link with Tom and confirm whether Acme wants a deeper, on-site-style failover demo (they hinted yes). Tom — expect the packet in ~4 hours.

Tom (Acme IT): Great, appreciate the quick turnaround. One last Q: can you confirm backup retention can be extended to 90 days for Dedicated?

Ethan (SE): Yes — retention configurable per contract for Dedicated. I can note pricing delta in the packet.

Maya (Sales): Noted — will include pricing note.

Priya (Security): Also logging: audit logs for control plane retained 90 days by default, extended retention available as an add-on. We'll include the log retention table.

Maya (Sales): Closing the loop — attaching the runbook link above and sending to Acme now. If they ask for a signed attestation we'll route to legal. :rocket:
